briefing.headline: US-China chip export controls tighten as OpenAI Orion-2 nears 90% on GPQA

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate toward AGI with new releases this month. Compute shortages persist while safety regulations lag deployment. Global race dynamics intensify ahead of Q4 funding peaks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys Orion-2 internally with major capability jumps. Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus and Google unveils Gemini 3 Ultra. Meta open-sources Llama 4 while xAI and DeepSeek compete on inference efficiency.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm production for AI chips. Microsoft and Google announce new $50B hyperscale data center builds in Texas and Arizona. NVIDIA Blackwell supply constraints continue into 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory frameworks in the US and EU converge fast enough to shape AGI deployment before 2028?
